==Description==
*'''A-200''' is an [[A-120]]-like entity, rebounding is a similar fashion, however with a twist. '''A-200''' has a Smart-Rebound system, where if a player is not hiding, it will not directly chase them, but will instead turn around.

==Mechanic==
*'''A-200''' will begin its spawn by knocking on the door, as a clear indication of its trap. Interacting with the door will cause instant death (forced, '''A-200''' doesn't need to see you).
*After a random of 3 to 5 knocks (2 to 3 in red rooms), '''A-200''' will do 5 extremely fast knocks before breaking the door.
*'''A-200''' will wait a short while before moving (2 seconds normally, 0.5s if A-135 was active (and not red rooms), and 0 seconds if red rooms were active), before moving backwards to the Void-wall at mediocre speed.
*From there, '''A-200''' has a 1 in 20 chance to rebound. Otherwise, he will de-spawn instantly.
*When '''A-200''' de-spawns, it will produce a ''Howl'' kind of sound, which can be heard from anywhere.
*While '''A-200''' is active, Claustrophobia is disabled until it de-spawns.
*Any player seen, no matter what, will instantly die.
*Does not locker snipe in red rooms.

==Strategy & Tips==
*Use a safe spot or hide until he de-spawns. That's it.

==Trivia==
*'''A-200''' 's rebound chance is a rare 1 in 20 chances (Unless someone in the server isn't hiding in a locker or table).
*'''A-200''' can only touch the main door (this is how astra classifies rebounds) 4 times before being forced to de-spawn.
*'''A-200''' will only knock once if [[A-135]] spawned in the same room.
*'''A-200''' kills you under tables.
*'''A-200'''<nowiki/>'s name is misspelled word "insidiae" ([een-SEE-dee-ae]), which means "ambush" in Latin.
*'''A-200'''<nowiki/> cannot snipe in the [[Red Rooms]]. Use this to your advantage!
*'''A-200'''<nowiki/> in the [[April Fools 2026]] Mode was the moon in the sky. You can see A-200 in the Lobby after using the S.P.A.W.N past door 200.
